task_criteria:
1. At the graded commit, `bash tests/selftest.sh` prints a final line starting `SELFTEST: PASS` and exits 0.
2. At the graded commit, `bash scripts/boardctl validate` prints a final line matching `RESULT: OK` and exits 0.
3. Both `.coding-hermes/board/tasks.jsonl` and `.coding-hermes/board/events.jsonl` parse with `jq -c . <file>` (exit 0), and `jq -r .id <file> | sort | uniq -d` prints nothing for each file.
4. `docs/audits/code-factory-sync-2026-11-04-0241.md` exists in the graded tree, contains the string `2c48149`, and contains the census `125 task rows`, `185 before this tick's own audit event` and `38 complete, 82 pending, 5 in_progress`.
5. `docs/ACCEPTANCE-PLAN.md` contains `Delta measured 2026-11-04 03:02 at tip` and `CF-053`, and `git show --numstat --format= HEAD -- docs/ACCEPTANCE-PLAN.md` reports zero deleted lines while reporting more than zero inserted lines.
6. `.coding-hermes/board/events.jsonl` ends with an `audit` event whose `actor` is `code-factory-sync`, whose `id` appears exactly once in the file, and whose `detail`, parsed with `jq -r '.detail | fromjson'`, carries `lane` equal to `code-factory-duckbrain-sync` and a non-empty `tip_measured`.
7. `git show --numstat --format= HEAD` reports zero deleted lines across every changed path of the graded commit.
